basic_details.job_title: NCRTC Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: National Capital Region Transport Corporation (NCRTC) Assistant Manager Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of NCRTC. A total of 3 Assistant Manager vacancies have been announced through the NCRTC Assistant Manager Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age: 40 years as on 31-07-2026. Age relaxation for SC/ST: 05 Years, OBC-NCL: 03 Years, PwBD: 10 Years, Ex-Servicemen: 05 Years.

qualification.education_qualification: Any Graduate (Full Time), Post Graduate Degree/ Diploma in Development Studies/ Social Welfare or Work/ Rural Development/ Public Administration/ Applied Social Science (2 years Full Time)
qualification.details: Assistant Manager/ Land & Acquisition: Any Graduate (Full Time) Assistant Manager/ Social: Post Graduate Degree/ Diploma in Development Studies/ Social Welfare or Work/ Rural Development/ Public Administration/ Applied Social Science (2 years Full Time)

selection_process: Written Test/ CBT (80% Weightage) Interview (20% Weightage) Document Verification Merit List
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NCRTC Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCRTC to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NCRTC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NCRTC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCRTC Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the NCRTC Assistant Manager recruitment is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Assistant Manager in NCRTC?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Assistant Manager post in the National Capital Region Transport Corporation.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Assistant Manager/ Land & Acquisition?
faq.answer: The educational qualification for Assistant Manager/ Land & Acquisition is any graduate degree (Full Time).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Manager posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Manager posts is 40 years as of 31 July 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NCRTC Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the NCRTC Assistant Manager recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager position?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Assistant Manager position ranges from Rs. 50000 to Rs. 160000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for NCRTC Assistant Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Written Test/ CBT, Interview, Document Verification, and Merit List preparation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online through the official NCRTC website.

faq.question: Q9. Does NCRTC offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, NCRTC offers age relaxation for SC/ST, OBC-NCL, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen categories.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the Important Links section of this article.
